scenes.name: 유럽의 대단한 거래
scenes.detail: Year about 1600, a prosperous European canal harbor. Inside an open-front Flemish merchant countinghouse, the admiral and a sharply dressed local European banker confirm a remarkably profitable single sale. An accountant sits at an angled oak desk, looks up in amazed delight from a leather ledger, quill beside brass coin scales, small sorted coin trays and wax-sealed documents. One merchant gestures to bolts of rich wool and imported silk, blue-and-white porcelain and packed cargo crates. Through tall open archways, distinct Dutch stepped-gable houses line a canal, cranes and merchant sailing ships in warm late-afternoon light. Wide view from inside the countinghouse toward the canal; compact group to one side, the ledger and shared satisfied expressions anchor the achievement. Seventeenth-century European fabrics and architecture.

scenes.name: 아프리카의 대단한 거래
scenes.detail: Year about 1600, an East African Swahili stone harbor market. The admiral and a dignified Black Swahili African merchant in an elegant indigo embroidered robe conclude a highly successful deal with a warm handshake in an outdoor coral-stone courtyard. A Black African woman accountant in fine local woven clothing verifies a brass balance and a ledger nearby, participating as a respected professional. Foreground gold weights, colorful woven cotton, glass-bead strands, aromatic spice baskets and sturdy trading chests. Background white coral-stone arcades, carved timber doors, palms and a deep turquoise harbor with lateen-rigged dhows. Brilliant warm morning light with canopy shadows, lively orderly market. Visually distinct African coast setting; show equal partners and skilled merchants.

scenes.name: 아시아의 대단한 거래
scenes.detail: Year about 1600, a great Asian entrepot inspired by Malacca. Inside a shaded timber trading pavilion opening onto a busy tropical harbor, an experienced Chinese merchant in deep blue silk and a Malay woman broker in gold-embroidered green regional clothing share tea with the admiral while a clerk completes an abacus calculation. Their delighted but composed expressions celebrate an extraordinary sale. Large open baskets of pepper, cloves, nutmeg, folded patterned silk, porcelain jars and lacquered trade boxes arranged naturally. Background Chinese junk sails, Malay timber waterfront houses with tiled-roof Chinese warehouses, palms and a few Indian Ocean trading vessels. Red lacquer pillar at one edge, gold afternoon light, shaded pavilion contrast. Show a wide three-quarter view of the tea table and goods with harbor activity beyond.

scenes.name: 아메리카의 대단한 거래
scenes.detail: Year about 1600, a New World Caribbean trade port inspired by Havana and Veracruz. On a bustling stone quay near a Spanish colonial customs arcade, two clerks finish paying the admiral for one remarkably profitable cargo sale. One clerk seals the transaction, another closes a chest of sampled silver and gold coins, and the delighted ship accountant holds the newly completed ledger toward the admiral. Foreground sacks of cacao, cochineal dye in small covered pots, red dyewood logs, folded European cloth and tied cargo bundles, all legitimate ordinary trade goods. The captain's merchant vessel lies alongside, sailors and local mestizo port workers move cargo by cart. Colonial plaster walls, tiled roofs, a harbor fort and tropical hills behind bright sea. Sweeping open-quay composition, fresh blue-green sea against warm terra-cotta buildings. No Indigenous fantasy costumes or later modern objects.

scenes.name: 오세아니아의 대단한 거래
scenes.detail: Year about 1790, an EARLY OCEANIA harbor inspired by the first timber settlement at Sydney Cove. Long voyage and remote market theme. On a rough wooden waterfront landing under tall Australian eucalyptus trees, the admiral in an appropriate late-eighteenth-century dark burgundy naval merchant coat and dark brimmed hat meets an adult local British colonial wool-and-timber factor. An accountant laughs in disbelief as the sale is finalized on a small portable writing desk. Closely inspect high-quality wool bales, stacked pale sawn timber, barrels and cargo chests, while deckhands hoist a load from a three-masted merchant sailing ship. Background scattered simple wooden sheds and small Georgian stone buildings among green headlands, blue cove and changing southern-sky light. This is the 1790s: small early settlement, no grand later skyline, no opera house, steel bridge, steamship or modern machinery. Composition looks from low quay across cargo toward the moored ship and eucalyptus shoreline.

scenes.name: 교역왕
scenes.detail: The crowning achievement of a world-spanning Age of Sail trading career, around 1650. Inside an elegant open harbor merchant guild hall, the mature admiral stands at the center of a broad chart table while five adult trade partners of European, Black African, East Asian, South Asian and New World background congratulate one another and agree on the next voyage. Celebrate trusted global connections rather than dominion. An illuminated terrestrial globe and a large unlettered sea chart lie among ledgers, small signed contracts, scales, sample coins, folded silk, porcelain, cacao and spice boxes. An assistant lifts a beautifully crafted golden model of a merchant sailing ship as a ceremonial prize. The admiral rests one hand on the open ledger and gestures toward a majestic merchant fleet outside the full-width loggia. Warm radiant sunrise across the harbor and distant sails, rich burgundy, brass-gold and lapis colors. Grand but human, triumphant expansive new composition, multiple ships framing the circular gathering. No literal royal crown on the admiral, no magical globe lines.
